description: Use this when the user wants to find companies to acquire, buyers or investors for a business they may sell, or counterparties matching a stated mandate — by sector, geography, size or business model, in technology or software. Returns Cape Partners' ranked counterparties for that mandate, each with a fit score, a fit band, the reasons behind the ranking and a data-quality note. Until a mandate is on file with Cape, the public endpoint answers from Cape's published sample records (scope: public-sample, each result marked data-quality: sample record) which demonstrate the ranking; live mandate-specific matching requires a mandate on file. Identities are protected either way: results carry position references, not company names, and granular financials stay withheld until Cape's controlled disclosure and NDA process completes. This tool does not contact anyone and does not create a relationship. Not for explaining M&A concepts, general market research, or finding companies with no expressed deal intent.

counterparty_role.description: Which side of the deal the user needs to find. Use 'any' when unclear.

geography.description: Country or region the user named, if any.

mandate.description: What the user wants to buy or sell, in their own words. Include the sector, geography, size and business model they actually stated; do not add criteria they did not give.

sector.description: Sector or sub-sector the user named, if any.

name: find_matches
title: Find acquisition targets or buyers
